correctness.rationale: For positive coefficients and n>=8 the log Jacobian is zero exactly when y_i alternates, forcing 4|n and parity balance; the cyclic recurrence proves sufficiency and the line description. At each full-torus point the logarithmic Hessian has alternating edge weights and two-dimensional 2-periodic nullspace, giving exact rank n-2. Removing the scale direction yields a nondegenerate normal Hessian to the projective critical line, so analytic Morse–Bott coordinates imply the ordinary double transverse equation and reduced Jacobian scheme. Exact rational samples for n=8,12,16 corroborate original gradients and Hessians but are not used as infinite proof.
